name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a bowl, whisk eggs and grated Parmesan cheese.
Cook bacon in a pan until crispy, then add minced garlic.
Drain spaghetti and add it to the pan with bacon and garlic.
Remove from heat, add the egg and cheese mixture, and toss quickly to coat the spaghetti.
Season with black pepper and salt to taste.
Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garlic, ginger, and spices for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and cook the marinated chicken until browned.
Remove chicken and sauté chopped onions in the same pan.
Add tomato puree, spices, and cook until the mixture thickens.
Add the chicken back to the pan and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in cream and cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve with rice or naan.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, cream together butter, sugar, and brown sugar.
Beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
Mix in flour, baking soda, and salt.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto a baking sheet.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool before serving.

name: Omelette
steps: Crack eggs and whisk.
Add salt and pepper while beating the mixture.
Add butter to pan on medium heat.
Pour mixture to pan and cook for one minute.
Flip the Omelette and cook for one more minute.
Serve.

name: French Toast
steps: Mix eggs with milk, sugar vanilla .essence and whisk well
Heat butter in a pan
dip bread slices in egg mixture for 30 seconds and let it soak
Then fry in pan till golden on both sides.
Serve hot with fruit honey or cream as per choice.

name: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Season beef strips with salt and pepper.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté onion until golden.
Add mushrooms and cook until softened.
Add beef and fry until browned.
Sprinkle flour and stir well.
Add beef stock and simmer until thickened.
Stir in mustard and sour cream, cook for 2 minutes.
Serve with rice or noodles.

name: Fish Tacos
steps: Season fish with paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan and cook fish until golden.
Warm tortillas in a pan.
Assemble tacos with cabbage, avocado, and fish.
Squeeze lime juice over the top.
Serve immediately.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a wok.
Add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add vegetables and stir-fry on high heat.
Add soy sauce and oyster sauce, stir well.
Drizzle with sesame oil before serving.
Serve hot with steamed rice or noodles.

name: Shepherd’s Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Cook minced lamb in a pan until browned.
Add onion, carrots, tomato paste, and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour in beef stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Prepare mashed potatoes with butter, milk, salt, and pepper.
Transfer meat mixture to a baking dish and top with mashed potatoes.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden.
Serve warm.

name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garlic, ginger, and spices for 30 minutes.
Heat butter in a pan and cook chicken until browned.
Add tomato puree and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in cream and cook for 5 more minutes.
Serve with naan or rice.

name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water until softened.
Heat oil in a wok and scramble eggs.
Add garlic and shrimp/chicken, cook until done.
Add noodles, fish sauce, soy sauce, tamarind paste, and sugar.
Stir-fry until noodles are coated.
Add bean sprouts and cook for 1 minute.
Garnish with peanuts and serve.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Combine cucumbers, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.
Serve chilled.

name: Beef Tacos
steps: Heat oil in a pan and sauté onion and garlic.
Add minced beef and cook until browned.
Add chili powder, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Fill taco shells with beef, lettuce, tomato, and cheese.
Serve immediately.

name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C (430°F).
Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly.
Top with mozzarella slices and basil.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 15 minutes until crust is golden.
Serve hot.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté onion and bell pepper.
Add garlic, paprika, and cumin, cook for 1 minute.
Pour in tomatoes, simmer for 10 minutes.
Make small wells and crack eggs into them.
Cover and cook until eggs are set.
Garnish with parsley and serve with bread.

name: Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar in a bowl.
Heat oil in a pan and cook chicken until golden.
Pour sauce over chicken and simmer until thickened.
Garnish with spring onions and serve with rice.

name: Falafel
steps: Blend chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, and spices into a paste.
Form mixture into small balls.
Heat oil in a pan and deep-fry until golden brown.
Serve with pita and tahini sauce.

name: Miso Soup
steps: Bring dashi stock to a simmer.
Stir in miso paste until dissolved.
Add tofu and nori, simmer for 3 minutes.
Garnish with spring onions and serve hot.

name: Ratatouille
steps: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté onion and garlic.
Add eggplant, zucchini, and bell pepper, cook until softened.
Add tomatoes, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Simmer for 30 minutes until thickened.
Serve warm as a side or main dish.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Grill chicken breasts and slice thinly.
In a bowl, combine lettuce, croutons, and parmesan.
Add chicken and drizzle Caesar dressing.
Toss well and serve immediately.

name: Chili Con Carne
steps: Heat oil in a pan and sauté onion and garlic.
Add minced beef and cook until browned.
Stir in tomato paste, chili powder, cumin, and paprika.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in kidney beans and cook for 10 more minutes.
Serve with rice or bread.

name: Pancakes
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter in another bowl.
Combine wet and dry ingredients into a smooth batter.
Heat a pan and pour batter to form pancakes.
Cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook the other side.
Serve with syrup or toppings of choice.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 bell peppers, tops cut off and seeds removed
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté onion and garlic.
Add minced meat and cook until browned.
Stir in rice, tomato sauce, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Stuff bell peppers with mixture and place in a baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes until peppers are tender.
Serve hot.

name: Lentil Soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onion, garlic, and carrots.
Add lentils, cumin, and vegetable stock.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 25 minutes.
Blend until smooth if desired.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with lemon wedges.
